scope: Real ReplayScene, standard Unity cameras and LineRenderer annotation geometry, actual forward/backward seeks and Full HD Game-view screenshots, with explicitly generated four-rig coordinates. No physical tracking/video acquisition claim.

sourceHashes.note: Camera/annotation source hashes match root exactly. Screenshot UI styling is the captured snapshot; replay_design is refining separate UI partials afterward.

changes: Dynamic near/far clipping projects current geometry bounds along camera depth and discards preceding contexts' far range.
Pose roots stay at unit scale; only the visible primitive marker body scales with screen pixels, preserving saved animal camera offsets.

Stable rig colors, screen-sized markers and pulsing halos, current recorded heading arrows, standard Camera.CalculateFrustumCorners wire frusta, faint full-trial paths and a bright five-second recent recorded tail.
On-screen rig tags and bounded directional off-screen tags avoid replay control chrome. Labels are suspended during media/file/fidelity dialogs.
Annotations are restricted to the operator layer; an actual animal-camera pixel comparison confirms zero image change when annotations are hidden.
limitations: Replay coordinate fixture is generated; it does not establish tracking/calibration or native video acquisition.
Screenshots use a real Full HD Unity Game view. The Mac packaged-player UI and shader inclusion still require root integration verification.
Heading arrow indicates the saved animal orientation; it is not a predicted future trajectory.
